newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BANKS MOST ACTIVE STOCKS ON BOURSE LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BANKS MOST ACTIVE STOCKS ON BOURSE LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that banking shares were the most active stocks last week.
The bourse said that Vilniaus Bank led block trades in trade of 5.37 million litas.
Hermis Bank was the most active share on the central market in trade of 767,000 litas. It also saw trade of 2.61 million litas in block trades.
Hermis was also the biggest gainer among the official and A group companies, rising 10 percent to 203.50 litas last week. It was followed by Rokishkis Cheese which rose by five percent to 42 litas.
Medienos Plaushas came third and edged up 4.26 percent to 11.99 litas.
Lietkabelis was the biggest group A loser last week, easing by 24.24 percent to 2.5 litas.
It was followed by Lietuva hotel which was down 12.87 percent to 27.01 litas.
